message:
Somewhat experimental optimisation pass:
Tattoo textures are compressed and generate mipmaps. Reduces a tattooed player's cost from +8.4mb in ram and +8.4mb in vram to +2mb (just in vram) compared to non-tattooed players

Zooming with scroll wheel whilst using the 3p orbit cam (holding alt in 3p) now consumes all scroll wheel input
Stops inventory hotbar from being cycled whilst zooming the camera

Setup 3p attach anims
Beancan, bee, smoke, supply signal and flashbang now use the grenade animation subsystem

Fix attached grenades having a delay until becoming visible
Attached grenades are visible once a "attach_reveal" viewmodel anim event fires
If the event happens before the actual grenade is spawned, show a predicted attached grenade until the real one spawns 
If the actual grenade is spawned before the event, hide the actual grenade until we get that event

Tattoo fading pass
Irritation converts to blur over fade to reuse existing samples
This is baked in the tattoo compositor (on the GPU if possible) so old tattoos stay blurred while new tattoos are sharp
Faded tattoos also gain a blue/green tint as if the pigment has faded
All somewhat experimental and subject to performance benchmarks

Fix bases decaying despite TC having upkeep when the decay tick gets slowed down on very high entity count servers
- change decay tick from being a hardcoded 5 entities per tick to budgetted to 0.25ms per tick
- in practice most servers won't hit this: this is 200k decay entities & 10 server FPS to start reaching the budget
- paces so we don't burn budget looping through the list too quickly

MeshPaintable3D uses 16-bit unorm UV buffer instead of Half float. Increases precision up to 32x without increasing memory since all 3d painted meshes have UVs in the 0-1 space. Fixes blotchy and jagged brush strokes. Also effects egg suit.

Lower quant from 1cm -> 1mm for position
- switch from sending delta position to sending quantized acceleration so we can keep 1 byte per update after moving to a 10x smaller quant
- if acceleration is larger than 0.127m / tick then it will send full acceleration (allows it to support instant teleports and large changes in velocity)
- will fine-tune values further

Switch from generic stream -> BufferStream in the EntityPositionBatchReader since both demos and network data share the same class of stream for packets

Send positions & rotations quantized
- reduce the 3x positions floats from 4 -> 1 bytes when they are within 1.27m per tick (1cm quantization)
- reduce the 3x rotations from 4 -> 1 byte when they are within 25 degrees per tick (0.2 degree quantization)
- will fine tune the values if it's too high a quant
- fallback to sending the full value when it changes by more than a delta
- tell the client what the quantization is so it can be changed during the session and be captured by demos

Add `packet_capture` command to capture outbound packets on the server
- will capture up until a certain size or time limit is reached
- writes to disk with 8MB buffer
- intended to allow capturing network data so we can simulate optimizations on the raw data
- no overhead when turned off

Budget group-change entity snapshots to fix client stutters when loading grids with large bases.
The server sent up to 512 snapshots per player tick, which flooded the clients receive tick instantly anyway

New server.snapshotsendrate (default 800/s per player) sets a budget from seconds (rather than ticks)
